You May Not Get The Happy Ending You Were Looking For.

The Story of Three Strangers...A Mother...A Father...And a Son.

The jubilant story of George Gershwin.

A tent theater that comes to the region further complicates things.

Beware the power of your own desires.

HELLO WORLD, I'M YOUR WILD GIRL

All the thrills of the roaring West!

And when events start spinning out of control, even Rheinhardt finds he must take a stand.

One a dauntless flyer, the other a relentless killer!

Gianluca De Ceglie / Gisella Franchi / Fabio Rizzi / Giampietro Bianchi
Ruggero De Ceglie / Sebastiano Credici / Fabio Rizzato / Marialuce Bianchi
42304: The story—in which an American heiress on holiday in South America falls in love with an Argentine horse breeder against the wishes of their families—takes a backseat to the spectacular location shooting and parade of extravagant musical numbers, which include the larger-than-life Carmen Miranda singing the hit “South American Way” and a showstopping dance routine by the always amazing Nicholas Brothers.
GLAMOROUS BUENOS AIRES NIGHT LIFE WITH SOUTH AMERICAN'S TANTALIZING, TORRID-VOICED CARMEN MIRANDA

THE SCREEN'S FIRST INNER SANCTUM MYSTERY!

Le sergent / Le vieux à la canne (voice)

I tell ya, chum...laughs it is!

They messed with the wrong man's daughter.

What the world needs now is a shining hero!

Solange, secrétaire et amant de Paul

The jury finds her innocent... well not too innocent!
